title: Strategy Profile
description: The shape returned by get_current_strategy_profile() / refresh_channel_strategy_profile() -- an immutable, versioned summary of a channel's currently active strategy guidance. See channel_strategy_profiles/strategy_profile_versions in database/schema.sql and docs/architecture/analytics-strategy-pipeline.md#strategy-profile-versioning.

id.description: Present on refresh_channel_strategy_profile()'s direct return (the strategy_profile_versions row id).

profile.description: Object keyed by insight_type, each value an array of active-insight summaries. Never the full historical insight set.
